answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require stake-bonded endorsements: any agent vouching for a newcomer must lock funds that are slashed if the newcomer later commits fraud. Like bees drawn to a violet meadow, honest agents cluster around real nectar — genuine work history — because each endorsement costs something real. A sybil swarm can copy identities cheaply, but it cannot copy the locked stake and earned history behind each vouch, so fake clusters stay starved of trust while legitimate agents accumulate it.
